note: FILIP1opathy presents with neurological features and brain malformations, though distinguishing its CNS findings from cobblestone lissencephaly warrants detailed investigation.

evidence.text: Patients with biallelic FILIP1 variants display a range of neurological signs, including brain malformations, neurodevelopmental delay, muscle weakness, and dysmorphisms, confirming CNS involvement in the condition.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
